sentences.text: Adult-onset autosomal dominant demyelinating leukodystrophy is linked to the gene LMNB1 in curated databases [e_bfd2ff20e8bd].
Autosomal dominant primary microcephaly is linked to the same gene, LMNB1, in curated databases [e_734463354677].
Constellate computed from these two links that the diseases share a causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two links [e_643b56d40a83].
Microcephaly is also linked to a second gene, DPP6, by curated evidence [e_ab2040c4ccef].
For the leukodystrophy, abnormal function of the autonomic nervous system is a curated, very frequent feature [e_1d0a54ea6f2e].
Bladder control problems from the autonomic nerves are listed as frequent, with a lower confidence of 0.6 [e_397e5ada2653].
These edges do not show why one gene can lead to two different conditions, and they list no symptoms for microcephaly [e_643b56d40a83].
